hero.title: We provide the best food for you
hero.description: Discover a unique dining experience where culinary mastery meets an elegant, cozy ambiance. We carefully craft every dish using only the freshest seasonal ingredients, rich traditional flavors, and a modern touch designed to satisfy every taste and create unforgettable moments.

specials.label: Chef's Selection
specials.title: Our Special Dishes
specials.description: Explore our carefully crafted dishes made with fresh ingredients, rich flavors, and a modern touch designed to satisfy every taste.

ribeye.title: Ribeye Steak with Herbs
ribeye.description: Juicy prime ribeye steak grilled to perfection, served with aromatic rosemary butter and roasted seasonal garlic.

salmon.title: Pan-Seared Salmon
salmon.description: Crispy-skinned Atlantic salmon fillet resting on a bed of creamy asparagus risotto and drizzled with lemon-herb oil.

fettuccine.title: Truffle Mushroom Fettuccine
fettuccine.description: Handcrafted fettuccine tossed in a rich, velvety wild mushroom cream sauce and infused with premium black truffle oil.

burrata.title: Burrata & Heirloom Salad
burrata.description: Creamy Italian burrata cheese paired with sweet heirloom tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and finished with a balsamic glaze.

duck.title: Duck Breast with Cherry Jus
duck.description: Tender duck breast served with a rich cherry jus, silky root vegetable purée, and delicate seasonal herbs.

scallops.title: Seared Scallops
scallops.description: Golden seared scallops paired with cauliflower purée, brown butter, fresh herbs, and a bright citrus finish.

risotto.title: Wild Mushroom Risotto
risotto.description: Creamy Arborio rice with wild mushrooms, aged Parmesan, fresh thyme, and a delicate touch of truffle.

fondant.title: Chocolate Fondant
fondant.description: Warm dark chocolate fondant with a molten center, complemented by vanilla cream and seasonal berries.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: A Passion for Food, Born in 2018
story.description: Deliciora began in 2018 with a simple idea — to bring exceptional food and warm hospitality together. Inspired by European cuisine, seasonal ingredients, and years of tradition, our restaurant grew into a place where memorable evenings are created around every table.

ourStory.label: Our Story
ourStory.title: More Than a Restaurant.
ourStory.titleAccent: A Story Built Around the Table.
ourStory.description: Deliciora was created from a passion for thoughtful European cuisine and the belief that the best evenings are built around more than food alone. Seasonal ingredients, warm hospitality, and an intimate atmosphere shape every experience we create.

beginning.label: THE BEGINNING
beginning.title: A Small Idea Became Deliciora
beginning.text: Deliciora began with a simple belief — that a restaurant should be more than a place to eat. It should be a place where atmosphere, thoughtful cooking, and genuine hospitality come together around one table.

philosophy.label: THE PHILOSOPHY
philosophy.title: Food With a Purpose
philosophy.text: Our approach is rooted in European cuisine, seasonal ingredients, and respect for simplicity. Every dish is designed to feel familiar yet refined, allowing quality ingredients and carefully balanced flavours to remain at the centre.
philosophy.imageAlt: Fresh ingredients, herbs and spices used in Deliciora cuisine

today.label: DELICIORA TODAY
today.title: A Place Built Around the Table
today.text: Today, Deliciora continues to evolve while staying true to the idea that started it all — creating memorable evenings through food, atmosphere, and the people gathered around every table.

chef.label: Meet the Chef
chef.title: The Craft Behind Every Plate
chef.description: Chef Adrian Moreau brings together European tradition and a modern approach to seasonal cuisine. His philosophy is simple — exceptional ingredients, thoughtful technique, and dishes created to be remembered.

newsletter.label: Stay Connected
newsletter.description: Be the first to discover seasonal menus, private dining events, and special evenings at Deliciora.
newsletter.note: No spam. Only something worth opening.

footer.description: European-inspired dining, seasonal ingredients, and memorable evenings crafted around every table.
